---
title: "Agent Skills"
---

captain-hook bundles two Claude Code [Agent Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) that automate adoption. One surveys a repository and sets up hooks from its conventions, and the other translates a prose style guide into enforced rules. Both ship in the PyPI wheel and as a Claude Code plugin, from the same source.

- `bootstrapping-hooks` surveys your repo's docs, CI workflows, lint configs, and git history, proposes categorized gates and nudges for your approval, then writes `.claude/hooks/*.py` with inline tests, verifies them with `uvx capt-hook test`, and wires `.claude/settings.local.json`.
- `translating-styleguides` turns a STYLEGUIDE.md, or the style sections of CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS/CLAUDE.md, into `StyleRule` classes, custom validation logic, or LLM hooks. It tiers each rule by what it needs and reports anything it can't enforce.

## Install as project skills

Run either command from your project root:

```bash
uvx capt-hook init                  # scaffolds hooks AND installs the skills
uvx capt-hook skills install        # skills only; --force refreshes existing copies
```

Either command copies the skills into `.claude/skills/`, where Claude Code picks them up after you accept workspace trust. Invoke them as `/bootstrapping-hooks` and `/translating-styleguides`, or ask in plain language such as "set up captain hook" or "enforce our style guide". `init` installs two more skills — `scanning-sessions` and `authoring-hooks` — that power the [session reviewer](../guide/session-reviewer.qmd); you do not invoke those directly.

In an interactive terminal, `init` finishes by offering to launch Claude with `/bootstrapping-hooks` right away. Accept and the survey-propose-write loop starts immediately in your repo. Accepting also registers the captain-hook plugin marketplace in `.claude/settings.local.json`, so the skills track the repository and update automatically.

Existing skill directories are never overwritten on re-run; use `uvx capt-hook skills install --force` to replace them wholesale after upgrading captain-hook.

## Install as a plugin

From inside a Claude Code session, run:

```
/plugin marketplace add yasyf/captain-hook
/plugin install captain-hook@captain-hook
```

Plugin skills are namespaced as `/captain-hook:bootstrapping-hooks` and track the repository. Each commit is treated as a new version, so updates arrive without a PyPI release.

## What's inside

Each skill bundles a `SKILL.md` plus `references/` files that it loads on demand, covering API tables, a pattern catalog, the matcher reference, and a tier-classification rubric. To read the full skill bodies, see the [Agent Skills reference](../reference/skills.qmd).
